name: mow-web-vercel-root
description: Root package.json for Vercel. The Vercel Dashboard's Root Directory / Build Command / Output Directory settings for this project are all unset (confirmed via `vercel pull`, which returns rootDirectory: null), so Vercel builds from the actual repository root. This file and the sibling vercel.json are the ones Vercel actually reads; its vercel-build script builds the real frontend from frontend/, and it declares the runtime dependency for the api/ Node.js serverless functions. REPO REORG NOTE (2026-09-08): the repo was reorganized into two top-level app folders, frontend/ and backend/ (backend/api, backend/supabase, backend/docs). backend/api is NOT auto-discovered by Vercel's Node builder, which only looks for an api/ directory at the actual build root — before deploying again, either move backend/api back to a root-level api/, or set the Vercel project's Root Directory and confirm a real deploy still finds the functions. Local dev (npm run dev in frontend/) is unaffected either way.

scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
